paragraphs.source_en: Those who desire to read further in economics should turn next to some work of intermediate length. Good volumes in this class, which will bring the reader abreast of recent refinements in economic thought, are Frederic Benham’s Economics (525 pages) and Raymond T. Bye’s Principles of Economics (632 pages). Both of these are widely used as college textbooks.

paragraphs.source_en: Among recent works which discuss current ideologies and developments from a point of view similar to that in the present volume are: Friedrich A. Mises’ Socialism is the most thorough and devastating critique of collectivist doctrines evet written. The reader should not overlook,finally, Frédéric Bastiat’s classic Economic Sophisms, and particularly his essay on What Is Seen and What Is Not-Seen.
